text: Understood, I've written both into the task list as TCL85. (1) A Reset engine button on the Engine tab. It asks for two taps, ends the running GitHub job, and starts a new one so GitHub gives it a fresh runner and address. It takes the engine's own bids down first and keeps the bet and bid records. It never touches your keys, trading switches or any Claude session. (2) Pull down to refresh on the Engine tab. It re-reads status, the bet list, trades, bids, usage and charts at once and shows when each was last read. I'll build both together with the update-notice fix (TCL83) and the faster-retry fix for Novig errors (TCL84a) in one release. A session that holds the repo lease will ship it, so I can't say exactly when.
